APOSTOLIC SUFFERING SUPPORTS RESURRECTION BELIEF · SEAN MCDOWELL
"this doesn't prove the resurrection is true"

McDowell uses this qualification in his final synthesis, limiting apostolic suffering to evidence of sincere belief and against conscious fabrication within a larger case.

"

THE MARTYRDOM EVIDENCE IS INSUFFICIENT · PAULOGIA
"we just have to explain how two people came to sincerely believe something"

Paulogia concludes his two-person alternative by arguing that the securely accepted Peter and Paul cases need no unusual collective-experience explanation.
